data.description: A count of the time periods of a full rotation of the Earth with respect to the Sun.
A count of the units of time conventionally reckoned as 1⁄24 of a day and scientifically reckoned between 3,599 and 3,601 seconds, depending on the speed of Earth's rotation.
A count of the  units of time that is approximately as long as a natural orbital period of the Earth's Moon.
A count of the a units of time equal to seven days
A count of the units of time equal to the orbital period of the Earth around the Sun.
A count of the units of time equal to 1/60th of a minute.
A count of the units of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.
